body:
## Pull request overview This pull request adds pagination support to the ListNodes API but includes unrelated files and workflow changes. The PR title "owner" is misleading and doesn't describe the actual changes. **Changes:** - Adds pagination parameters (limit, offset) and total count to the ListNodes protobuf API - Implements paginated database queries for listing nodes globally and by user - Updates CLI to support pagination flags with informational output - Includes unrelated workflow optimizations for golang Docker image caching - Includes unrelated tool artifacts (.snapshots, .DS_Store) ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 12 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | proto/headscale/v1/node.proto | Adds limit, offset, and total fields to ListNodes request/response | | hscontrol/db/node.go | Implements ListNodesPaginated function with count and pagination logic | | hscontrol/db/users.go | Implements ListNodesByUserPaginated for user-filtered pagination | | hscontrol/db/node_test.go | Adds comprehensive test coverage for pagination functions | | hscontrol/state/state.go | Adds state layer methods for paginated node listing | | hscontrol/grpcv1.go | Updates ListNodes handler to support pagination with backward compatibility | | cmd/headscale/cli/nodes.go | Adds --limit and --offset flags with pagination info display | | gen/go/headscale/v1/node.pb.go | Generated protobuf code for new pagination fields | | .github/workflows/test-integration.yaml | Unrelated: adds golang image caching optimization | | .DS_Store | Unrelated: macOS system file that should not be committed | | .snapshots/* | Unrelated: third-party tool artifacts that should not be committed |
